'''Red Heart''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that was part of [[Yurf Col]]'s [[Duro Squadron|task force]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was destroyed during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|87|''Red Heart''}}</ref>
